package comments
import (
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "sync"
 "github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/ast"
 "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/rule"
)
var adamicCaptureLock sync.Mutex
func adamicRecord(value any) {
 if os.Getenv("ADAMIC_LEADING_CAPTURE")=="" {return}
 adamicCaptureLock.Lock();defer adamicCaptureLock.Unlock()
 file,err:=os.OpenFile(os.Getenv("ADAMIC_LEADING_CAPTURE"),os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY,0600);if err!=nil {panic(err)}
 defer file.Close();if err=json.NewEncoder(file).Encode(value);err!=nil {panic(err)}
}
func adamicComments(values []Comment) []map[string]any {
 result:=[]map[string]any{};for _,c:=range values {result=append(result,map[string]any{"start":c.Range.Pos(),"end":c.Range.End(),"block":c.IsBlock,"text":c.Text,"line":c.StartLine,"column":c.StartColumn,"endLine":c.EndLine})};return result
}
func LeadingRunFor(ctx rule.Context,node *ast.Node) []Comment {
 result:=adamicOriginalLeadingRunFor(ctx,node)
 source:="";start:=-1;all:=[]Comment{}
 if ctx.SourceFile!=nil {source=ctx.SourceFile.Text();all=ForFile(ctx)}
 if node!=nil && ctx.SourceFile!=nil {start=rule.TokenRange(ctx.SourceFile,node).Pos()}
 adamicRecord(map[string]any{"mode":"leading","source":source,"start":start,"file":ctx.SourceFile!=nil,"comments":adamicComments(all),"want":adamicComments(result)})
 return result
}
func isAdjacentGap(text string,from,to int) bool {
 result:=adamicOriginalIsAdjacentGap(text,from,to)
 adamicRecord(map[string]any{"mode":"gap","source":text,"from":from,"to":to,"want":result})
 return result
}
